meta.name: redesign-existing-projects
meta.description: Upgrades existing websites and apps to premium quality. Audits current design, identifies generic AI patterns, and applies high-end design standards without breaking functionality. Works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将现有网站和应用的视觉设计提升至高端品质
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有设计粗糙的网站或应用，想在不破坏功能的前提下提升视觉品质
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade existing websites and apps to premium visual quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a rough-looking site or app and want to elevate its design without breaking functionality

howto.what: Claude 会先读现有项目代码，识别框架与样式方案，再逐项检查字体、配色、布局、交互状态、文案、图标和代码质量，然后在原有技术栈里做针对性升级，不从零重写。
howto.when: 当你要求把已有的网站或应用升级设计，并希望保留现有功能与技术栈时用它；对任何 CSS 框架或原生 CSS 都适用。

say.text: 审查这个项目的前端，列出所有通用的 AI 设计痕迹
say.note: 会先扫描代码再给出诊断清单

say.text: 按你的规范升级现有页面的字体、配色和布局，不要重写
say.note: 改动留在你原有的技术栈里

say.text: 检查我的组件是否缺 hover、focus、加载和错误状态
say.note: 会指出缺失的交互状态并补上

howto.what_en: Claude reads the existing codebase, identifies the framework and styling method, audits typography, color, layout, states, copy, icons and code quality, then applies targeted upgrades within your current stack instead of rewriting it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to upgrade the design of an existing website or app while keeping its functionality; it works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.

say_en.text: Audit this project's front end and list every generic AI design pattern
say_en.note: It scans the code first, then gives a diagnosis

say_en.text: Upgrade the typography, color and layout of this page, don't rewrite it
say_en.note: Changes stay inside your current stack

say_en.text: Check whether my components are missing hover, focus, loading and error states
say_en.note: It flags missing states and adds them
